sentence: This project builds accelerator chips that solve the Boolean satisfiability problem using less time and energy.
This project builds an open-source community ecosystem that helps researchers compare the performance of robot manipulation approaches.
This project holds a conference where smaller institutions share ways to manage research data and use computational methods.
This project studies a method that links short simulations together to make it possible to optimize chaotic dynamical systems.
This project designs a vertical NAND memory built with a ferroelectric transistor so that computations can happen inside the memory.
This project links international networks working on nano-manufacturing and quantum information sciences to advance manufacturable quantum technologies.
This project builds a tool that uses deep learning to find different kinds of events in intracranial electroencephalography recordings.
This project builds computer vision systems that give several possible explanations for the shapes and materials in an image instead of just one.
This project uses scanning probe microscopy to image electronic and magnetic properties in two-dimensional materials that are only a few atomic layers thick.
This project builds a framework that monitors hazard workflows to help combat physical and cyber threats.
This project gives teachers research experiences in nanotechnology and helps them build classroom learning modules.
This project builds voltage controlled switches that route microwave signals between separate quantum chips.
This project builds sensors that detect multiple biomarkers simultaneously and uses machine learning to interpret the results.
This project builds fairness-enhanced knowledge graphs from social media data to learn about the cycle of youth violence.
This project develops methods that combine artificial intelligence and quantum computing to study data from particle physics experiments.
This project studies how the genes and physical traits of sucking lice determine which mammal host species they can parasitize.
